Read the hand-off notes docs/port/W01.md to W09.md, FIX1.md, W12.md and W13.md first. DECISIONS R22-R24 apply. Apply DECISIONS R20 (NoStepTrigger where the original canTriggerWalking returns false; Mth.floor for coordinate casts) and the W04 XP lesson (1.7.10 EntityAnimal.getExperiencePoints returns 1 + rand.nextInt(3) regardless of experienceValue - check each entity's base class before porting XP). ENTITY PORTER CONTRACT as in docs/port/waves/w06.json goal. BOSS RULES: virtual health from W01 combat for every boss above 1024 (R4: King 7000, Queen 6000, Mobzilla 4000, Young Adult Prince 3000, Young Prince 1500) applied after the original per-hit caps; the 1.7.10 armor formula (R5) with the original getTotalArmorValue branches; heads stay separate entities that follow the body and forward hits (R9); King attack from the class (250), not the config (R3); boss bars; custom flight in customServerAiStep; EnderDragon part damage with explosion source verified in the sources (catalogue 6.3); the Ultimate King state spawns exploding PurplePower without a cap (R18); ThePrinceAdult turns into TheKing under FullPowerKingEnable. Back-edges from earlier waves: grep 'TODO W10' (AttackSquid calling Kraken, Cephadrome damage against Kraken, spawn eggs) - fill in owned files, report the rest.
